system.description:
Named for the Goya print, this power reaches into a victim's mind and conjures forth hobgoblins — caricatures of the target's own insecurities and bad memories — and sets them upon him.

MET System: Spend one Blood Trait and one Mental Trait for each hobgoblin conjured, up to your Generation's blood expenditure limit. Each hobgoblin has Physical Traits equal to 5 plus the victim's total Negative Physical Traits, Health Levels equal to 13 minus the victim's Self-Control/Instinct plus Courage (halved if using the compressed scale), and strikes for two levels of lethal damage. Hobgoblins affect only their intended victim, ignoring everyone else, and melt away within an hour or once their target is destroyed.
